title: Transcript-to-gene SummarizedExperiment workflow with sequence MD5 provenance verification, abundance-weighted effective length and sample metadata alignment
source_relation: adapted: Bioconductor transcriptome import, sequence-digest provenance verification, abundance-weighted effective length aggregation and sample alignment expressed as a SummarizedExperiment constructor workflow
difficulty_hypothesis: Agents use digest::digest() with its default serialize = TRUE (producing the wrong MD5 hash of the R object header), compute unweighted mean effective lengths instead of TPM-weighted lengths, fail to fall back to unweighted mean when all isoform TPMs in a gene-sample cell are zero, overwrite coldata row names instead of aligning by sample name, or include unquantified manifest transcripts in n_transcripts and manifest_md5.

mcp_relevance.rationale: Constructing a valid SummarizedExperiment with multiple named assays, aligned rowData/colData S4 DataFrames, metadata(), and digest::digest(serialize = FALSE) requires exact Bioconductor and CRAN API conventions that R-Knowledge-MCP surfaces via get_function_docs and search_r_documentation.
mcp_relevance.information_need: SummarizedExperiment assay/rowData/colData/metadata constructor contract and digest::digest(serialize = FALSE) character-hashing behavior.
mcp_relevance.obtainable_without_mcp: partly: ?SummarizedExperiment and ?digest are installed in the Bioconductor image
alternative_solution_paths: SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(counts = ..., abundance = ..., length = ...), rowData = ..., colData = ..., metadata = ...)
rowsum() for counts/abundance and weighted rowsum(eff_len * tpm) / rowsum(tpm) for lengths

calibration_risks.ceiling: low-moderate: multi-step Bioconductor container + digest + weighted aggregation contract
blockers: requires the Bioconductor scorer and executor images

pinned_evidence.oracle: explicit per-gene loop in base R computing sum(counts), sum(tpm), and TPM-weighted effective lengths with zero-TPM fallback, plus tools::md5sum cross-check against digest::digest(serialize = FALSE)
